beta.notes:
Nav, Home, Training, muscle taxonomy and Library refactor.

- Floating pill tab bar (Home / Training / Library) with a detached Pump button; Pump is now a modal and badges when a workout is running. Schedule and Progress are absorbed into Training.
- Muscles are a fixed two-level tree (7 groups, 27 muscles). Exercises target several muscles, one primary, and gain an equipment field. Workout screens show the subgroups trained.
- Training tab: month activity grids, cumulative activity summary vs the previous period (30D/3M/6M/1Y), strength volume by muscle group, per-exercise progression, activity history with text import.
- Home: "Today, <date>" opening a calendar drawer, weekly snapshot with week-over-week deltas, one timeline mixing your activity with people you follow, PR trophies.

Requires database migrations 031-033.

Fixes: exercise edits could leave an exercise with no muscles and drop it from every chart; imported exercises matched no muscle filter; the home timeline stopped after one page; failed fetches showed "no activity yet" instead of an error; list rows sat under the Pump button; durations could read "1h 60m"; Body Stats regained an entry point on the profile screen.

nightly.notes:
Home now opens on your activity rings, the whole app uses the real iOS
navigation and tab bars, and launching no longer flashes black.

**New**
- Activity rings on Home: steps, workout minutes and cardio for the day. Swipe
  the card for the week's totals, or tap it for the last 30 days and to set
  your goals.
- A rest day has no workout target, so a day off doesn't count against you.
- Today's workout sits as a chip under the date. Tap it to start.
- Apple Health reports your weekly steps, daily average and step streak.

**Improved**
- The tab bar is the real iOS one. It gets out of the way as you scroll, grows
  with your text size, and VoiceOver reads it properly. Pump is a tab now.
- Home, Training, Library and Pump have real navigation bars: the title starts
  large and shrinks into the bar as you scroll, with content blurring beneath.
- Library's search is the system search field, with a Cancel button, and it
  hides as you scroll.
- Feed cards are one layout for workouts and cardio, built around the name you
  gave the session, in the colour you chose for it.
- A workout's personal records are one chip with a medal and a count.
- The activity calendar on Training uses three distinct colours, so one workout
  no longer looks like three.
- A past workout opens with its name in the bar and edit, share and delete
  beside it.
- Timers and other counting numbers no longer jitter as the digits change.

**Fixed**
- Launching flashed black for over a second between the splash and the app.
- Large titles didn't move when you scrolled — content slid over them.
- A past workout showed its name twice.
- Your profile had no back arrow.
- The same workout reported different set counts in different places, and an
  exported workout wrote the wrong number to the file.
- A public profile's Weight moved counted sets you had skipped.
